metadata.description: Azure region for all resources. Defaults to the resource group location.
Entra ID tenant ID (key-vault + workload-identity). az account show --query tenantId -o tsv
Networking inputs: vnetName, vnetAddressPrefix, aksSubnetName/Prefix, ilbSubnetName/Prefix, anfSubnetName/Prefix.
AKS inputs: clusterName, kubernetesVersion, dnsPrefix, nodePools[], and optional autoUpgradeProfile + autoScalerProfile objects.
Azure NetApp Files inputs: anfAccountName and pools[].
Container registry: mode create|shared. shared uses resourceId + loginServer; create provisions a new ACR.
Key Vault inputs: keyVaultName, purgeProtectionEnabled, softDeleteRetentionInDays.
Workload Identity inputs: uamiNamePrefix, services[].
Optional gateway static public IP: gatewayPipName, sku (Standard|Basic).
Optional DNS zone: createZone, zoneName, dnsName, appRecordName, authRecordName.

Virtual network and subnets for AgentStudio. Creates one VNet with three subnets: AKS nodes (Azure CNI), internal load balancer, and Azure NetApp Files (delegated to Microsoft.Netapp/volumes). Deploy this template before AKS and ANF.
Name of the virtual network.
Azure region; defaults to the resource group location.
Address space for the VNet (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16).
Name for the AKS node subnet.
CIDR for the AKS node subnet (e.g. 10.0.0.0/22). Must be large enough for nodes and Azure CNI pod IPs.
Name for the internal load balancer subnet.
CIDR for the internal load balancer subnet (e.g. 10.0.4.0/24). Must not overlap other subnets.
Name for the Azure NetApp Files delegated subnet.
CIDR for the ANF delegated subnet (e.g. 10.0.8.0/24). Must not overlap other subnets.

AKS cluster for AgentStudio. Provisions a Free-tier Base SKU cluster with Azure CNI, a Standard load balancer, OIDC issuer and workload identity enabled. Node pools are fully data-driven from the nodePools array (one System pool minimum; add User pools for workload isolation). Per-pool autoscaling, cluster auto-upgrade channels (autoUpgradeProfile), and cluster-autoscaler tuning (autoScalerProfile) are all parameterized. A Network Contributor role assignment is created on the AKS subnet so the cluster can manage network resources. Deploy networking.json first and pass its aksSubnetId output as aksSubnetResourceId.
Name of the AKS managed cluster.
Azure region; defaults to the resource group location.
Kubernetes version. Check supported versions: az aks get-versions -l <region> --query 'orchestrators[].orchestratorVersion' -o tsv
DNS prefix for the cluster FQDN. Must be unique within the region.

Full resource ID of the AKS node subnet. Get from networking.json output: aksSubnetId. Example: /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/<vnet>/subnets/<subnet>

One object per agent (node) pool. At least one pool with mode=System is required. Required keys per pool: name, mode (System|User), vmSize, count, enableAutoScaling (bool), minCount, maxCount, osDiskSizeGB (0=SKU default). Optional keys: osSKU (default Ubuntu), osDiskType (default Managed), maxPods (default: Azure default for the network plugin), availabilityZones (array, e.g. ['1','2','3']), nodeLabels (object), nodeTaints (array, e.g. ['workload=gpu:NoSchedule']), maxSurge (default 10%). minCount/maxCount are ignored when enableAutoScaling=false but must still be present.

Cluster auto-upgrade channels. upgradeChannel: none|patch|stable|rapid|node-image (Kubernetes version auto-upgrade). nodeOSUpgradeChannel: None|Unmanaged|SecurityPatch|NodeImage (node OS image auto-upgrade).

Cluster-autoscaler tuning (applies when any pool has enableAutoScaling=true). Pass-through object of kebab-case keys per AKS ARM API, e.g. scan-interval, scale-down-delay-after-add, scale-down-unneeded-time, expander, max-graceful-termination-sec, balance-similar-node-groups. Empty {} = Azure defaults.
Kubernetes service CIDR. Must not overlap any VNet subnet (default clears AgentStudio layout: aks 10.0.0.0/22, ilb 10.0.4.0/24, anf 10.0.8.0/24).
Cluster DNS service IP; must be within serviceCidr.

Azure NetApp Files account and capacity pools for AgentStudio. Creates the ANF account and one capacity pool per entry in the pools array. Volumes are provisioned dynamically by the Trident/AKS storage classes and are NOT managed by this template. Deploy networking.json first — ANF requires a subnet delegated to Microsoft.Netapp/volumes. Cost note: ANF billing is on provisioned pool size, not on volume usage.
Name of the Azure NetApp Files account.
Azure region; defaults to the resource group location. Verify ANF availability: az netappfiles list-available-locations.

One object per capacity pool. Required keys: name, serviceLevel (Standard|Premium|Ultra), sizeTiB (>=1, billed on provisioned size), qosType (Auto|Manual), coolAccessEnabled (bool; requires Premium/Ultra). Optional key: encryptionType (Single|Double, default Single).

Azure Container Registry for AgentStudio. To allow AKS to pull images, grant the AKS kubelet identity the AcrPull role after deployment: az role assignment create --assignee <kubeletIdentityObjectId> --role AcrPull --scope <registryResourceId>.
Globally unique ACR name (5-50 alphanumeric chars, no hyphens). Example: cragentstudiodeveus2001
Azure region; defaults to the resource group location.
ACR service tier. Standard includes 100 GiB storage. Premium required for geo-replication and private endpoints.
Enable the admin user for username/password pull access. Set false for production workloads that use managed identity exclusively.
Enable zone redundancy (requires Premium SKU).
Grant AcrPull on a shared Container Registry to the AKS kubelet managed identity.
Object ID of the AKS kubelet managed identity.
Full resource ID of the shared ACR (scope for AcrPull).
Grant AKS kubelet identity Reader on the deployment resource group (required before Trident dynamic provisioning).
Object ID of the AKS kubelet managed identity.
RBAC-enabled Azure Key Vault for AgentStudio Workload Identity secrets.
Globally unique Key Vault name (3-24 chars, alphanumeric and hyphens only). Example: kv-agentstudio-dev-eus2-001
Azure region; defaults to the resource group location.
Entra ID tenant ID. Run: az account show --query tenantId -o tsv
Set true for production vaults. False keeps dev iteration fast.
Soft-delete retention period. Minimum 7 days; use 90 for production.

Per-service UAMIs for AgentStudio Workload Identity. Creates one UAMI + federated credential per service, and assigns Key Vault Secrets User at the vault level. The services[].resources[] field documents intended per-secret access for a future PR that narrows scope to individual secrets.
Azure region for the UAMIs.
OIDC issuer URL of the cluster. For AKS: az aks show -g <rg> -n <cluster> --query oidcIssuerProfile.issuerUrl -o tsv
Key Vault name. Each service UAMI receives Key Vault Secrets User on this vault.
Entra ID tenant ID. Run: az account show --query tenantId -o tsv
Name prefix for the UAMIs. Final UAMI name: <prefix><serviceName>.
Array of { name, namespace, resources[] } objects. resources[] entries document intended per-secret access (future PR). The canonical list is generated at deploy time by `make wi-list-services`.
Static public IP for the Istio/Gateway LoadBalancer. Reference in deployments/helm/edge/values-aks.yaml via azure-pip-name annotation.
Name of the public IP resource (e.g. pip-agentstudio-gw-preprod-eus2-001).
Optional Azure DNS public zone with app/auth A records pointing at the gateway static IP.
Azure DNS zone resource name (e.g. agentstudio-preprod-example-com).
FQDN of the zone with trailing dot (e.g. agentstudio-preprod.example.com.).
Relative name for the console host (app.<zone>).
Relative name for Keycloak (auth.<zone>).
IPv4 address of the gateway public IP.
AKS cluster name.
AKS OIDC issuer URL (workload identity federation).
AKS kubelet identity objectId.
AKS kubelet identity clientId (Trident ANF managedIdentityClientID).
ANF account name.
Primary ANF capacity pool name (first entry in anf.pools).
VNet name for Trident backend.
ANF delegated subnet name for Trident backend.
Container registry login server (shared or stack-created).
Key Vault URI.
Gateway public IP name for edge Helm (azure-pip-name annotation).
Gateway public IP address.
ANF delegated subnet ID (for Trident backend virtualNetwork).
Azure DNS zone name when createZone=true.
